evidence_rules: Pre-independence current-territory Lithuanian tennis does not inherit USSR-wide player counts or outcomes.
Lithuanian biographical and institutional evidence is partial and therefore does not justify high confidence for national scale.
The 1959 federation presidium, 1995 LTS establishment and 2022 federation mandate are gated to their documented years.
Current federation structure is not backcast into earlier decades.
9+ remains world-leading and is not reached by this evidence set.
